items.question: Are you a licensed electrician?
items.answer: Yes — all work is carried out by a licensed, insured electrician in line with Victorian electrical safety requirements.

items.question: Do you handle emergency callouts?
items.answer: Yes. Call 0468 31 32 33 and we'll talk through what's happening and get someone out as soon as we can.

items.question: Will I get a quote before work starts?
items.answer: Always. You'll get a clear, fixed price before any work begins — no surprises on the invoice.

items.question: What suburbs do you cover?
items.answer: We're based in Kealba and regularly work across Sunshine, St Albans, Deer Park, Albion, Keilor, Taylors Lakes and Sydenham.
